profile.headline: "Innovative Software Engineer | Fullstack Developer | Expert in Scalable Backend Solutions and User-Centric Applications | Passionate about Technology and Problem-Solving"
profile.summary:
Innovative Software Engineer with expertise in both frontend and backend development, combined with a strong background in Psychology and Computer Engineering. Proficient in developing scalable and user-centric applications with a keen attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Experienced in working within collaborative environments to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Detail oriented and accustomed to high stress, fast-paced environments. Computer literate, HR Policy creation, Employee relations, Account Management, Communication, public speaking and Budget planning.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Sole programmer, in charge of all processes: design, code, debug, test, launch.
•	Spearheaded development of client-specific software solutions, increasing productivity by 30%.
•	Created cross platform application that function on Windows and Mac.
•	Integrated third-party APIs to enhance system functionality.
•	Conducted code reviews, promoting a collaborative and high-quality coding environment.
•	Actively participated in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to team members and fostering a collaborative development environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Programming · Back-End Web Development · Communication · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · HTML

positions.title: General Merchandise Team Leader
positions.description:
Understand sales goals, plan and execute daily/weekly workload to deliver on department and store sales goals and guest engagement. Including: merchandising, pricing, transitions, revisions, sales plans, sampling, promotions and price change.
• Enable a consistent experience for guests by ensuring product is in stock, available, accurately priced and signed on the sales floor.
• Enable efficient delivery to our guests by leading pick, pack and ship fulfillment work.
• Assess General Merchandise backroom, sales floor areas and fulfillment reporting to identify gaps and develop a plan to resolve.
• Expert of operations, accuracy, process and efficiency.
• Oversee execution of processes in inbound, outbound, replenishment, inventory accuracy, presentation, pricing and promotional signing processes for select GM areas of the store.
• Create a scheduling plan in partnership with your leader based off of monthly and weekly business workload and guest traffic.
Train and develop team members into viable teams leads
• Enable team members to stay up-to-date on relevant trends and products.
• Evaluate and recommend candidates for open positions and develop a guest-centric team.
• Lead team onboarding and learning.
• Establish clear goals and expectations and hold team members accountable to expectations.
• Lead and coach the team to ensure accuracy and efficiency in all GM processes.
• Close knowledge and skill gaps through training and experiences.
• Work a schedule that aligns to guest and business needs (this includes early morning, evening, overnight shifts and weekends).
• Provide service and a shopping experience that meets the needs of the guest.
• Demonstrate a culture of ethical conduct, safety and compliance. Lead and hold the team accountable to work in the same way.
• Address store needs (emergency, regulatory visits, etc.).

positions.title: Backroom Team Leader
positions.description:
Ensure that backroom accuracy is above 97.5% daily.
Audit locations that contain anomalies such as product misplacement and unknown product placement.
Supervise and train Team Members in all backroom practices, including training with industrial equipment.
Run and maintain store reports such as the Backroom Accuracy report and Online pick up report,
Ensure that the OPU (online pick up) is above 95% daily.
Create, maintain and audit location for current and incoming product. 
Supervise receiving department which oversees incoming vendors as well as product coming from central distribution.

positions.title: Facility Director
positions.description:
Creating an healthy atmosphere for employees while simultaneous protecting the company from any possible liability. 
Social Media campaigning to draw in vendors to donate to the company. This resulted in an additional 18% of the annual budget alone.
Create and implement new employee management policy that was adopted into other departments and eventually became universal.
Spearheaded policy that increased employee efficiency by 32% and decreased miscommunication within company ranks 
Talent acquisition and employee relations.  
Maintaining contact with CSWs on well being of youth's in care.

positions.title: Behavior Specialist
positions.description:
provide school based behavioral therapy to youths.
Monitor and analyze behavioral trends and formulate behavior intervention plan.
Use ABA methods throughout session.
Use CPI appropriately when required.

positions.title: Youth Specialist
positions.description:
Use CYC and ABA tactics to provide a stable environment for troubled youths in order to minimize crisis situations.
Use Pro-Act training in crisis situation in order to provide the utmost safety for youth specialist and youths.
Build rapport and actively engage with youths and families in order to provide a safe place for therapy and rehabilitation.
Supervise youths at all times.
Write legal doctrine to DCFS of Los Angeles cataloging maladaptive behavior of youth.
Advocate for youths in a court of law.
Survey and Log condition of living quarter via Title 22 checklist.

positions.title: Behavioral interventionist
positions.description:
•	Administer ABA to individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder
•	Create and Implement programs to correct social behavior 
•	Abide to standards of HIPAA compliance with participants
•	Run trainings on ABA strategies and Admin policies with staff
•	 Assist program manager with report compilation quarterly

positions.title: Direct Staff
positions.description:
•	Administered DTT (Discreet Trial Training) to clients with developmental disorders
•	Create and implement ABA strategies for consumers  
•	Discussed behavioral models with clients’ parents for further reform 
•	Trained and supervised new staff 
•	Compiled reports for review by regional center

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Jewish Federation of Greater Los Angeles
volunteerExperiences.description: It was an amazing experience, I was able to truly get an insight into the jewish culture be seeing the community come together to donate and support. I was able to see first hand how difficult yet rewarding fundraising is, I also got to know leaders within the community.

company.name: The Jewish Federation of Greater Los Angeles
